params.body:
The desk showed what was being written; what gentells.com carried, and why, was nowhere to be seen.

The Studio now opens with two modes:
- **Write**: the desk as it was.
- **gentells.com**: three tabs.
  - Posts: live on the site (with a link to each), in review, drafts headed for the site.
  - Trends: waiting for a decision (put on the site, skip), live with the reason each is there (view, hide), hidden (put back).
  - Reports: the existing shelf.

Mode and tab live in the URL (`?mode=site&tab=trends`). The switch hides while a piece is open in the editor.

Needs the pipeline PR with `/site/trends` merged first. Checked locally with `npm run build` and a Playwright run against mocked API responses.
params.title: Studio: a gentells.com mode with posts, trends and reports
